commit_message: Complete ADR0133 Remote AI Studio browser validation
pr_title: ADR0133: complete Remote AI Studio first-release validation
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes the remaining ADR0133 first-release evidence on current main by capturing the production Remote AI Studio companion in real Microsoft Edge at desktop, narrow, and mobile widths. The deterministic visual fixture is initialized after the loopback gateway is running so fallible fixture setup cannot terminate Editor construction; fixture failures are surfaced through the visual-validation marker.

This supersedes the stale validation candidate in #668 and the old exact-head carrier #677. PR #291 remains the older superseded draft.

## Validation

Requires full Windows Validation because scripts/ci changes, Automation Regression, and ChatGPT visual review of the generated Remote AI Studio screenshots.
